ref_to_cand.proof:
fun {X} {Y} [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] f hf {x} hx =>
  Eq.mpr (id _simp_1)
    (Exists.casesOn (Eq.mp _simp_1 hx) fun w h =>
      Exists.casesOn
        (Eq.mp
          (forall_congr fun {X} =>
            forall_congr fun [MetricSpace X] =>
              forall_congr fun {Y} =>
                forall_congr fun [MetricSpace Y] =>
                  forall_congr fun f =>
                    implies_congr (Eq.refl (UniformContinuous f)) (forall_congr fun x => implies_congr _simp_1 _simp_1))
          (@SemantEqRef.exercise_4_11a) f hf x (Eq.mp _simp_1 hx))
        fun w_1 h_1 =>
        And.casesOn h fun left right =>
          And.casesOn h_1 fun left_1 right_1 =>
            And.casesOn right fun left_2 right =>
              And.casesOn right_1 fun left_3 right_2 =>
                Eq.mp
                  (forall_congr fun {X} =>
                    forall_congr fun [MetricSpace X] =>
                      forall_congr fun {Y} =>
                        forall_congr fun [MetricSpace Y] =>
                          forall_congr fun f =>
                            implies_congr (Eq.refl (UniformContinuous f))
                              (forall_congr fun x => implies_congr _simp_1 _simp_1))
                  (@SemantEqRef.exercise_4_11a) f hf x (Exists.intro w ⟨left, ⟨left_2, right⟩⟩))
